implemented_with_limitations.pdf-compress: Rewrites and compresses page content streams. A PDF may not shrink if its embedded assets already dominate its size.
implemented_with_limitations.pdf-text: Extracts selectable text only; scanned pages need OCR.
implemented_with_limitations.pdf-docx: Recreates extracted text in a basic DOCX; page layout, images and complex formatting are not preserved.
implemented_with_limitations.docx-pdf: Creates a text-first PDF; original layout, images and complex formatting are simplified.
implemented_with_limitations.image-compress: Re-encodes JPEG/WEBP at the selected quality and losslessly optimizes PNG; size may increase.
implemented_with_limitations.image-resize: Proportional maximum-width downscale only; no crop or upscale.
implemented_with_limitations.image-strip-metadata: Re-encodes supported raster formats and omits EXIF metadata; animated image frames are not preserved.
implemented_with_limitations.extract-zip: Returns a new ZIP with sanitized, flattened filenames; it does not write archive paths onto disk.
implemented_with_limitations.xml-format: Rejects DTD and entity declarations; not intended as a validating XML schema engine.
